prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: production pixel-art sprite sheet for Rhythm Dojo Unity game.
Input image: reference sheet. Use ONLY the young male trainee in the TOP ROW, never the old men or props.
Primary request: draw NEW anatomically articulated animation frames of this EXACT young trainee: same face, black topknot, red headband with tails, cream crossover tunic with dark teal collar and cuffs, red waist sash, baggy dark teal pants, cream shin wraps, brown shoes. Match reference proportions, outline, palette and crisp pixel texture closely. ALL poses face screen RIGHT.
Composition: one regular sheet, exactly SIX equal columns and FIVE equal rows, 30 full-body sprites, one sprite centered in each cell. Transparent RGBA background, NO floor, NO shadows, no text, no grid lines. Keep identical camera, scale, character size, pixel density in all cells. Every standing foot baseline at 90% of cell height; head at about 12%. Leave room on both sides for a fully extended kick, no overlapping cells. Ideally 1536x1280.
Row 1, six chronological subtle breathing frames: relaxed two-fist guard matching reference pose; inhale begins; chest/shoulders rise ONE pixel with shirt folds changing; soft inhale peak; exhale; same relaxed guard. Feet and leg pixels identical, face and head steady, no whole-body bob or scaling.
Row 2, six frames straight RIGHT punch: idle guard; rear elbow draws back and hips turn; fist moves halfway forward; one arm fully extends horizontally in a clear fist punch while other guards; elbow retracts; idle guard.
Row 3, six frames RIGHT front kick: idle guard; weight supported on rear leg, front knee chambers high; lower leg unfolds; leg fully extends to right at waist height with visible shoe sole, opposite foot firmly planted, arms counterbalance; kicking knee folds back; foot returns to original guard. REAL new leg silhouettes.
Row 4, six frames vertical jump: knees deeply bend and arms lower; bent legs push off and arms rise; both feet visibly airborne with knees tucked and body higher inside cell; airborne apex with both knees flexed; both feet land on baseline with bent knees/torso absorbing impact; recover upright guard. Preserve vertical air gap in frames 3 and 4, do not make floating idle.
Row 5, six frames training readiness and wrist loosening: relaxed guard; bring hands together at chest; grip one wrist and gently stretch while head looks toward right target; loosen shoulders with elbows outward; settle into stronger wider guard; return relaxed guard.
Constraints: recognizable SAME reference character every frame; adult limb anatomy, exactly two arms and two legs, coherent clothing and face. Genuine redrawn poses, no rotated copies, no blur, no motion trails, no smooth vector shading.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact sprite sheet ONLY to remove the pale white/off-white background and ALL background haze/shadow to fully transparent RGBA (alpha 0). Preserve all 30 characters EXACTLY, all rows/columns, positions, dimensions, poses, faces, clothing colors, outlines. Do not redraw, rearrange or crop. Skin/cream tunic/shin wraps must remain opaque. No shadow or floor. Transparent background between and around every sprite.

Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: production pixel-art animation sheet for Rhythm Dojo.
Input image: character identity reference, exact SAME young adult female senior martial-arts instructor. Preserve friendly face, black high ponytail with red ribbon, cream sleeves, dark teal sleeveless vest with gold edging, dark teal baggy trousers, red long waist sash, cream wrapped shins, brown shoes. No old man, no sword, no extra accessories.
Primary request: genuine new articulated martial-arts animation poses for THIS woman, all facing screen LEFT, matching reference drawing and proportions.
Composition: exactly SIX equal columns and SIX equal rows (36 frames), regular grid filling square sheet, preferably 1536x1536. Each whole figure has same size/camera/pixel density. Center body within each cell with margin for punches/kicks left. Standing soles at 92% cell height; head/ponytail near 10%. Completely TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no floor, no shadows, no grid, no lettering.
Row 1 six subtle breathing frames in relaxed hands-near-waist ready stance: rest, inhale onset, slightly expanded chest and lifted shoulders, gentle inhale peak, exhale, rest. Head and legs remain steady. Feet exactly identical throughout row. No body scaling/bobbing.
Row 2 six LEFT straight fist punch frames: ready stance; elbows chamber and knees flex; striking fist halfway forward; full horizontal extended fist punch to LEFT with other fist at waist; retract; ready. Clear fist not palm.
Row 3 six LEFT front kick frames: ready; lift left-facing front knee while back foot supports; unfold shin; fully extended waist-high kick LEFT with shoe visible, torso balanced and counterbalancing arms; fold knee; replace foot and recover. Real anatomical changed leg poses.
Row 4 six martial stance frames: relaxed stance; bend knees and bring fists to chest; turn hips slightly and separate hands; hold strong low balanced fighting guard; relax arms; original relaxed stance. Same kind of ready guard a trainee can imitate.
Row 5 six teaching signal frames: relaxed; turn head toward trainee on LEFT; lift open hand slightly at chest; open palm inviting trainee to watch; lower hand; relaxed. Keep feet planted.
Row 6 six approving nod frames: relaxed; warm smile; head tilts gently down with lowered chin; eyes briefly close and nod lowest; head rises; relaxed with warm smile. Subtle single nod, no bow, no huge movement.
Constraints: same face, clothing, proportions every frame, crisp restrained pixel art like reference. Consistent aligned planted feet. No smoothing, blur, outlines around cells, motion trails, extra limbs, rotated copies.

preparation: DojoAnimationAssetBuilder bakes point-filtered 128x128 cells with common foot anchors and identical lower-leg pixels for breathing. Sources and legacy sage art are preserved.
